name: UnifyAir Core
description: High-performance 5G Core Network Functions implementation in Rust based on 3GPP Release 17. Async-first architecture built on Tokio with AMF (Omnipath), UPF (DataWarp), and SMF (InfiniSync).

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-bake.hcl and .dockerignore files present in repository structure

eval_notes: Only Rust-based 5G core. Early development (AMF implemented, UPF/SMF planned). Interesting for performance benchmarking against C/Go alternatives. AI capabilities planned.
